nodes.title: Note: Model Storage & Custom Nodes
widgets_values:
# Model Storage Location

```text
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    ├── diffusion_models/
    │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
    ├── text_encoders/
    │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
    ├── vae/
    │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
    │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
    ├── checkpoints/
    │   └── sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors
    └── loras/
        └── H3-Person-Remover-V1.safetensors
```

Select these files in the matching loaders. An existing shared model directory also works when ComfyUI is configured to use it.

## Custom nodes

Install [H3 Relay](https://github.com/akatz-ai/h3-relay) under `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/h3-relay/`. This canvas requires the **Relay 2.0 toolkit**. Use a current ComfyUI with native H3, SAM3 and Start Loop / End Loop support; restart after installing nodes. FFmpeg and FFprobe must be on PATH.

Blue nodes are H3 Relay helpers; the surrounding groups show where they fit. Green nodes are user inputs. Red nodes save output.

nodes.title: READ ME · Setup & defaults
widgets_values:
# Person Remover V1 · H3 Relay 2.0

1. Upload a **24 fps source video** and a **clean version of source frame zero**, with exactly matching dimensions and framing.
2. In **SAM person description**, identify the person to remove. Check that the green guide covers the whole person.
3. Describe the background to reconstruct in **H3 prompt**.
4. Run and review the completed windows. Reroll controls are in **Review Windows** at the output.

**Defaults:** 22-frame windows, 18-frame history; 12 steps, `er_sde` / `simple`, CFG 1, sigma shift 12 / 3.

The clean first frame is a visual reference, not a pixel lock. Removing a person visually does not remove their voice.

nodes.title: Note: Size Settings Reference
widgets_values:
# MiniMax H3 · Size Settings Reference

**24 fps · width and height divisible by 32.** Match the source aspect ratio. More pixels, longer windows and larger reference images require more memory.

| Approx. MP | Landscape reference |
|---|---|
| 0.21 | 608 × 352 |
| 0.31 | 736 × 416 |
| 0.41 | 864 × 480 |
| 0.52 | 960 × 544 |
| 0.64 | 1056 × 608 |
| 0.74 | 1152 × 640 |
| 0.82 | 1216 × 672 |
| 0.94 | 1280 × 736 |
| 1.03 | 1344 × 768 |

These are manually chosen reference sizes. **1344 × 768 exceeds a strict 1 MP cap.**

This canvas reads the source size directly. Resize the source and clean first frame together before loading; they must match exactly. The table does not resize your inputs.

nodes.title: Note: Windows, History & Review
widgets_values:
# Windows, history & review

H3 window sizes follow **17n + 5**: 22, 39, 56, 73, 90, 107, 124…

| Window | Duration at 24 fps |
|---|---|
| 22 frames | 0.92 s |
| 39 frames | 1.63 s |
| 107 frames | 4.46 s |
| 124 frames | 5.17 s |

**History 18** carries generated context into the next window. Keep history smaller than the window. The planner owns source ranges and seeds; native loops execute them. Assembly trims repeated overlap and padding back to the source frame count.

Keep the loop connections intact. The groups separate inputs, models, masks, planning, conditioning, sampling and output; they do not change execution.

**Review Windows:** previews persist with the saved workflow. Reroll regenerates a chosen window onward while keeping the exact accepted prefix. Preserve ComfyUI/output/__h3_removal_cache when moving the workflow. Changed media/models/settings invalidate incompatible checkpoints.

Generated audio is internal history. The saved video is silent by default; connect source audio to Create Video to retain the soundtrack.

**Memory:** Text Stage Memory and Sampling Workspace manage stage transitions. They respect explicit high-VRAM mode. Normal offloading was required for the unchanged fixture on 24 GB cards; this is not a blanket memory-fit guarantee.
